  • Class
    Description
    ClientEyeRuntime
    Loader-neutral owner of every client eye simulation and its lifecycle: mobs, boats, placed heads, framed items, items in hands (first and third person), and GUI items.
    ClientEyeRuntime.DrawContext
    One draw scope: the eyes chosen for the placed head being submitted and its partial tick, or the item being submitted, the item animation selected for it, and the GUI identity of the slot it is drawn in.
    ClientEyeRuntime.GuiKey
    Coordinates are used only for generic previews; slots and cursor items use logical indexes.
    ClientEyeRuntime.GuiKind
    What a ClientEyeRuntime.GuiKey identifies an item by.
    ClientLifecycle
    Per-tick and disconnect housekeeping for client-side eye state, shared by every loader's client hooks.
    ClientNetworkHandler
    Applies the server-to-client payloads on the client game thread.
    ClientRenderLayers
    Installs the vanilla-model eye layer on living renderers after renderer rebuilds.
    EyeInspector
    Client action-bar verdict for whether the aimed entity or placed mob head can currently receive googly eyes.
    GooglyTracker
    Per-entity client-side eye state: the GooglyTracker.EyeInfo pupil-physics simulator for every configured eye, plus which BehaviorInstance (if any) is currently playing on that entity.
    GooglyTracker.EyeInfo
    Physics state for one pupil: its position and velocity in the eye's unit disk, the head orientation used to derive angular forcing, and the non-physical overlay values (grow/blink/tint) an active behavior writes each tick.
    PresentationEyes
    One presentation's loose eye or configured eye layout, its ambient expressions, and, for an eye in a hand, the server's reactions.
    PresentationEyes.Draw
    The animation a draw uses and that draw's partial tick; PresentationEyes.Draw.NONE outside animated draws.
    PresentationEyes.Holder
    Implemented on render states, so an animation chosen at extraction reaches the later draw.
    SlimyEyeIrisTint
    The Slimy Eye iris tint: the stack's stored iris color.
